explication: DeepTeam is a local LLM red-teaming framework: an engineer configures a target model and risk scenarios, the framework simulates attacks, submits test cases to the target, and evaluates replies with LLM-as-a-judge metrics to produce scored findings. Its broader product includes guardrails, trace analysis, code scanning, risk-framework mappings, a CLI, and an optional hosted results integration. The sampled sources substantiate attack refinement and vulnerability assessment/evaluation; unsampled subsystem wiring is represented only where documented, so some links are intentionally omitted.
